description: Private mobile and desktop workflows for EmberBanter streaming, podcasts, research and local production checks.

defaultPrompt: Plan my next EmberBanter gaming stream.
Develop an EmberBanter podcast episode with researched talking points.
Check my streaming and podcast setup and work through the remaining device tests.
interface.longDescription: Plan gaming streams and podcasts, research episode topics, check Xbox/OBS audio routing, draft clips and release copy, and use bundled local tools for software diagnostics, operator preflight, audio loudness, two-pass MP3 exports, RSS XML drafts and authenticated read-only OBS status. Chat workflows support phone and desktop. Local checks require an executing computer, Python and the relevant installed binaries; the plugin does not host an OBS bridge or automatically publish.

name: emberbanter-studio
